title.narrative: Moving the HIV and TB responses towards 95-95-95 and sustainability with a focus on key and vulnerable populations - Honduras (01-Jan-2026-31-Dec-2027)

description.narrative: Honduras, TB/HIV, GLOBAL COMMUNITIES, INC. (GC Honduras)This program has the following goals: Implementar una respuesta multisectorial para garantizar el acceso universal a servicios integrales de VIH y tuberculosis, con énfasis en la calidad y la calidez de la atención, y en el cumplimiento de los derechos humanos. / Implement a multisectoral response to ensure universal access to comprehensive HIV and tuberculosis services, with an emphasis on the quality of care, a nurturing care, and on the fulfillment of human rights. The objectives of this program are: Desarrollar actividades de prevención y control de la TB en población vulnerable. / Develop TB prevention and control activities in vulnerable populations.
